title: Internal: handling procedure for granting a Personal Training Packages loyalty bonus session
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a package has come due for its complimentary loyalty bonus session, the agent credits that bonus session to the package's own balance.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): grant_bonus_session_f02d8384.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package being credited, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.
- sessions_delta: the whole number of bonus sessions to credit to the package, a non-negative whole number of sessions, passed as the full number of sessions owed.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the new ledger entry's reference number, the number of sessions credited, and the package's session balance afterward; the presence of a new reference number indicates the grant was recorded successfully. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no ledger entry is created.
